capabilities: aggregate outstanding TODOs from the vault into a single list view
split TODOs into Today, Scheduled, Inbox and Someday/Maybe lists
schedule a TODO for a date by adding a date tag
complete TODOs and jump to their source file from the list view
inherit daily note dates as due dates for undated TODOs
extras: README lists a roadmap of unfinished features (rescheduling from the list view, cache persistence, filtering); screenshots are referenced but not shown.
problem: TODOs scattered across many notes are hard to see and track, since Obsidian has no single view of outstanding tasks.

relations.evidence: Integrates with the Daily Notes plugin: TODOs without a due date will inherit the date of the daily note

summary: Task aggregator that collects outstanding TODOs from across the vault into Today, Scheduled, Inbox and Someday/Maybe lists.
